vinyl.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: closed 1024-square game vessel artwork, "vinyl".
Input image: the attached design/art/style-sheet.png is the approved style reference. Match this style exactly.
Draw a single original vinyl record half inserted in a plain paper record sleeve. The record is a simple ink-blue/navy circle, with a tiny plain brass centre circle and sparse circular grooves. The square sleeve is cream paper with a plum border and simple abstract ink-blue, light-blue and wax-red shapes only. No album art, people, faces, recognizable marks, or typography. The sleeve sits clearly in front of the lower half of the record and has a clean open top; the record's upper semicircle is visible above it. The sleeve must look complete and intact if the record slides vertically up out of it. Keep the silhouette strong at 40 px and 120 px.
One centered object on transparent canvas. Visual object width no more than about 740/1024; lowest opaque point at about y=900; at least 100 px transparent above the record. Closed, resting pose. No floor, cast shadow, ground, extra objects, visual effects, or separate panels.
original design, no logos, no brand names or brand shapes, no characters, no text

App: 時光膠囊 / Time Capsule. People send a sealed letter that can only be opened at a set time and place. Mood: tender, human, nostalgic, "precious in the AI age". Hand-inked storybook, not glossy 3D.
- Clean ink line art with a slightly hand-drawn line, flat colour fills plus one soft shading tone, a little paper grain, light hatching only (it must still read at about 120 px). Lines in plum #6E2B3F or navy #16263F.
- Palette only: ink blue #2F5D8A, light blue #5A8FD0, glass blue #DCE8F2, plum #6E2B3F, brass #C9A15A, wax red #A3364F, navy #16263F, paper #F6F8FB, cream #F3E2BB. Warm brown wood is allowed for wooden objects.
- Front three-quarter view, soft top-left light. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real brands.
- Transparent background, object centred, generous padding (object fills about 70% of the canvas), square.
Match the attached style sheet exactly.
